title: Telegram Message
description: Represents a message sent in a Telegram chat. Can contain text, media, files, stickers, locations, contacts, or service information.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier inside the chat

message_thread_id.description: Unique identifier of a message thread to which the message belongs; for supergroups only

from.description: Sender of the message; empty for messages sent to channels

sender_chat.description: Sender of the message when sent on behalf of a chat

date.description: Date the message was sent in Unix time

forward_from.description: For forwarded messages, sender of the original message

forward_from_chat.description: For messages forwarded from channels or anonymous admin messages, information about the original sender chat

forward_date.description: For forwarded messages, date the original message was sent in Unix time

reply_to_message.description: For replies in the same chat and message thread, the original message

edit_date.description: Date the message was last edited in Unix time

text.description: For text messages, the actual UTF-8 text of the message

entities.description: For text messages, special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands etc.

caption.description: Caption for the animation, audio, document, photo, video or voice

caption_entities.description: Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands in the caption

new_chat_members.description: New members that were added to the group or supergroup

left_chat_member.description: A member was removed from the group

new_chat_title.description: A chat title was changed to this value

successful_payment.description: Message is a service message about a successful payment

via_bot.description: Bot through which the message was sent

id.description: Unique identifier for this user or bot

is_bot.description: True if this user is a bot

language_code.description: IETF language tag of the user's language

is_premium.description: True if this user is a Telegram Premium user

can_join_groups.description: True if the bot can be invited to groups

can_read_all_group_messages.description: True if privacy mode is disabled for the bot

supports_inline_queries.description: True if the bot supports inline queries

title.description: Title for supergroups, channels and group chats

username.description: Username for private chats, supergroups and channels

first_name.description: First name of the other party in a private chat

last_name.description: Last name of the other party in a private chat

is_forum.description: True if the supergroup chat is a forum

description.description: Description, for groups, supergroups and channel chats

invite_link.description: Primary invite link, for groups, supergroups and channels

member_count.description: Number of members in the chat

offset.description: Offset in UTF-16 code units to the start of the entity

length.description: Length of the entity in UTF-16 code units

url.description: For text_link only, URL that will be opened after user taps on the text

user.description: For text_mention only, the mentioned user

language.description: For pre only, the programming language of the entity text

total_amount.description: Total price in the smallest units of the currency

shipping_option_id.description: Identifier of the shipping option chosen by the user
